name: GSA pricing (GSW__c=true) at 50% of list
what_it_tests: A GSA/GSW federal-contract line prices at ListPrice * 0.5 (or GSA pricebook variant, e.g. TeamQuest TQG); a standard GSW__c=false/null line is excluded from GSA halving
proc_mechanism: GSA Pricing (GSW__c Equals true) formula ListPrice * 0.5 -> InputUnitPrice; negative branch leaves catalog/attribute price
expected_behavior: GSW=true: InputUnitPrice = ListPrice * 0.5, no partner stacking; GSW=false: catalog/attribute price retained
test_setup: GSW__c=true GSA/federal line, Qty=2; plus a GSW__c=false standard direct line

prior_run.actual: Force-repriced both. GSW=true (00781466): List=10000 -> NetUnitPrice=5000=10000*0.5 exactly, UnitPrice=5000, Base/Pre_Partner=5000, NetTotal=5000, Partner%=null (no stacking). GSW=false (00781467): NOT halved (NetUnitPrice=0, not 5000); =0 not 10000 is the known E-03/SC-3359 OneTime net-zeroing, not a GSA step.
prior_run.notes: GSA gate GSAPricing (GSW__c Equals true) + GSAPricing36 FormulaBasedPricing InputUnitPrice=ListPrice*0.5 (V21 seq 48-49) verified live on real records. GSW=true OneTime line nets to exact half list and overrides the OneTime-zeroing, proving the GSA write fires and survives. GSW=false control nets /bin/zsh (Subscription/OneTime product) due to the separate SubscriptionPricing OneTime branch defect filed as E-03/SC-3359 -- NOT attributable to the GSA step (GSA negative branch correctly leaves the line). GSA mechanism PASS.
